summary: goose is a Rust AI-agent framework whose CLI binary `goose` (crate `goose-cli`, entry `crates/goose-cli/src/main.rs`) runs a single headless task with `goose run --text "<prompt>"` and exits when the agent finishes. Provider and model come from `GOOSE_PROVIDER` / `GOOSE_MODEL` env vars (read before any config.yaml, so no config file or wizard is needed); the Anthropic provider (`crates/goose-providers/src/anthropic.rs`) POSTs streaming requests to `${ANTHROPIC_HOST}/v1/messages` with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, so pointing `ANTHROPIC_HOST` at the proxy routes every model call through it. Tool calls are auto-approved with `GOOSE_MODE=auto`; the `developer` (shell/file editing) and `todo` extensions are enabled on the command line with `--with-builtin developer,todo` since an absent config.yaml yields no extensions. `GOOSE_PATH_ROOT` relocates config, the sqlite session store (`data/sessions.db`) and tracing logs (`state/logs/cli/<date>/`) under /out. The binary is built from the copied source with the CI-tested `--no-default-features --features portable-default` set, which drops the V8/llama.cpp local-inference, D-Bus keyring and self-update features so no extra system libraries are needed at build or run time.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      ca-certificates curl git bash \
      build-essential pkg-config cmake \
      libxcb1 libgomp1 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

ENV RUSTUP_HOME=/opt/harness/rustup \
    CARGO_HOME=/opt/harness/cargo \
    CARGO_NET_RETRY=10 \
    CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL=sparse

RUN mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin && \
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs \
      | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none --profile minimal --no-modify-path

COPY . /opt/harness/src

RUN cd /opt/harness/src && \
    CHANNEL="$(sed -n 's/^channel *= *"\(.*\)"/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)" && \
    /opt/harness/cargo/bin/rustup toolchain install "$CHANNEL" --profile minimal --no-self-update && \
    /opt/harness/cargo/bin/cargo build --release -p goose-cli --bin goose \
      --no-default-features --features portable-default && \
    install -m 0755 target/release/goose /opt/harness/bin/goose && \
    rm -rf target /opt/harness/rustup /opt/harness/cargo

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
run_command: export GOOSE_PATH_ROOT="${GOOSE_PATH_ROOT:-/out/goose}"; mkdir -p "$GOOSE_PATH_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || { export GOOSE_PATH_ROOT=/tmp/goose-home; mkdir -p "$GOOSE_PATH_ROOT"; }; set -o pipefail; goose run --text "$TASK" --with-builtin developer,todo 2>&1 | tee "$GOOSE_PATH_ROOT/run.log"
notes:
Build: compiling the goose workspace from source in release mode is heavy (expect 20-40+ minutes and several GB of scratch space); the toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml (1.96.1) is installed with the minimal profile, then the rustup/cargo dirs and target/ are deleted to shrink the image. The feature set `--no-default-features --features portable-default` is the one the repo's own CI uses for portable Linux builds; it excludes local-inference (V8/llama.cpp, needs libclang/cmake-heavy builds), system-keyring (D-Bus), code-mode (V8) and the self-updater, none of which matter for headless tasks. cmake is installed only as a safety net for aws-lc-sys (rustls backend). The repo's .dockerignore applies to the build context (drops .git, target, .github, ui build output); nothing the Rust build embeds is excluded.

Runtime: `goose run --text` is non-interactive by default (no `--interactive`), the telemetry consent dialog is skipped for non-interactive runs and additionally disabled via GOOSE_TELEMETRY_OFF, and GOOSE_MODE=auto auto-approves tool calls. With no config.yaml goose loads zero extensions, so `--with-builtin developer,todo` is required for shell/file tools. Session transcript (sqlite `data/sessions.db`), tracing logs (`state/logs/cli/<date>/`), and the tee'd stdout (`run.log`) land under /out/goose; if /out is not writable the run falls back to /tmp/goose-home. Add `--max-turns N` to the run command to bound agent iterations (default 1000).

OpenAI alternative (api_style openai): GOOSE_PROVIDER=openai, OPENAI_HOST=$PROXY_URL, OPENAI_BASE_PATH=v1/chat/completions, OPENAI_API_KEY=proxy, GOOSE_MODEL=gpt-4o. Avoid model names matching gpt-5*/o-series with the default base path, since goose then switches to the Responses API endpoint (/v1/responses) which the proxy does not serve; an explicit OPENAI_BASE_PATH containing chat/completions forces chat completions regardless of model name.
